THIRD revision - earlier entries were guesses, this is from the actual Shortcut logic. The 'Sleep' Shortcut fires nightly when iOS Wind Down begins and always turns on EXACTLY ONE fan: Dads fan if outdoor >=40F; otherwise it reads the bedroom sensor and picks Dads fan if the room is >=70F, else Moms Fan. So it is one fan essentially every night, year round - not two always-on (first estimate, 90W, too high) and not mostly-off in winter (second estimate, too low). ~30-60W while running, 45W used here. Runs from Wind Down until the 2-hours-after-sunrise automation switches it off, roughly 8-10h, so about 0.4 kWh/night ~ $25-30/yr. This IS inside the ~320W overnight floor. The separate 11:59PM Bedroom Temp rule can also start Dads fan in a 69-72.9F window - overlapping logic, same device.
